title: Daily send count
description: sends/daily-count.json -- the single-object counter lib/smtp_send.py uses to enforce sending.daily_cap and, when sending.warmup_ramp_days is set, ramp up to it. Not a per-day log; this file is overwritten in place.

send_days.description: count of distinct days with an external send (internal-domain sends don't count); drives the warmup ramp tier
